title: Google auth rejects invalid token with 400
description: POST /api/v1/user/auth/google/ with an invalid/garbage access_token (e.g. {"access_token": "invalid_token_example"}) must return HTTP 400 (not 500). Do NOT attempt the success/200 path — a real Google token is unavailable. Confirm the response body is JSON describing the validation error.

title: GET /me requires auth and returns current user
description: GET /api/v1/user/me/ with no Authorization header returns 401. With the CLIENT bearer token it returns 200 and a JSON object containing email 'ts_client@example.com' and role 'client'.

title: Vendor can create/update own profile
description: Using the VENDOR bearer token, PUT /api/v1/vendors/me/ with {company_name, location, specialties (array), capacity} returns 200 and the updated profile. Then GET /api/v1/vendors/me/ returns 200 reflecting the update.

title: List vendors and retrieve vendor detail
description: With the CLIENT bearer token, GET /api/v1/vendors/ returns 200 with a list. Pick a vendor id from the list and GET /api/v1/vendors/{vendor_id}/ returns 200 with that vendor. A non-existent id returns 404.

title: Vendor portfolio create, list, delete
description: With the VENDOR bearer token: POST /api/v1/vendors/me/portfolio/ as multipart form-data with an image file plus title returns 201. GET /api/v1/vendors/me/portfolio/ returns 200 including the new item. DELETE /api/v1/vendors/me/portfolio/{item_id}/ returns 204.

title: Client creates a design request
description: With the CLIENT bearer token, POST /api/v1/requests/ with JSON {title, description, apparel_type: 'hoodie', quantity: 100, material, color_preferences, sizes: [{"size":"M","quantity":50},{"size":"L","quantity":50}]} returns 201 with a request id and status 'open'. Missing required fields (e.g. no apparel_type/quantity) returns 400.

title: List and retrieve design requests
description: With the CLIENT token, GET /api/v1/requests/ returns 200 list. Create a request first if needed, then GET /api/v1/requests/{request_id}/ returns 200 with matching data. Non-existent id returns 404.

title: Only owner can update a design request
description: Create a design request with the CLIENT token. PATCH /api/v1/requests/{request_id}/ with the CLIENT token updates it (200). PATCH the same request with the VENDOR token must be forbidden (403) or not-found (404) — a non-owner cannot modify it.

title: Vendor places a bid on a request
description: Prereq: a client design request exists (create one with CLIENT token) and the VENDOR has a profile (TC003). With the VENDOR token, POST /api/v1/bids/ with {design_request: <id>, proposed_price: 1500.00, delivery_days: 20, message} returns 201 with status 'pending'.

title: Duplicate bid from same vendor rejected
description: After TC009, POST /api/v1/bids/ again with the VENDOR token for the SAME design_request must return 400 (unique bid per vendor per request constraint), not 500.

title: Invalid bid values rejected
description: With the VENDOR token, POST /api/v1/bids/ with proposed_price <= 0 or delivery_days < 1 returns 400. Bidding with a missing/invalid design_request id returns 400 or 404.

title: Client accepts a bid, creating an order
description: Prereq: a pending bid exists on the client's request (TC009). With the CLIENT token, PATCH /api/v1/bids/{bid_id}/status/ with {status: 'accepted'} returns 200 and the bid becomes 'accepted'. The parent request status becomes 'awarded'. Then GET /api/v1/orders/ with the CLIENT token returns 200 and includes the new order.

title: Vendor withdraws a pending bid
description: Create a fresh request+bid. With the VENDOR token, POST /api/v1/bids/{bid_id}/withdraw/ on a pending bid returns 200 and status becomes 'withdrawn'. Withdrawing an already-accepted bid returns 400.

title: Order production update is forward-only
description: Prereq: an active order exists (via TC012). With the VENDOR token, POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/production-updates/ with {stage: 'cutting', note} returns 201. Posting an earlier stage than current (e.g. 'sourcing' after 'cutting') returns 400 (forward-only enforcement).

title: Client confirms delivery to complete order
description: Prereq: an active order (TC012). With the CLIENT token, POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/confirm-delivery/ returns 200 and the order status becomes 'completed'. A vendor token calling confirm-delivery should be forbidden.

title: Review creation on a completed order
description: Prereq: a completed order (TC015). With the CLIENT token, POST /api/v1/reviews/ with {order: <id>, rating: 5, comment} returns 201. Posting a second review from the same reviewer for the same order returns 400 (unique constraint). A rating outside 1-5 returns 400.

title: Notifications list, mark read, mark all read
description: With the VENDOR token (who should have received a 'new_bid'/'bid_accepted' notification during earlier flows), GET /api/v1/notifications/ returns 200 list. POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read/ returns 200 and is_read becomes true. POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all/ returns 200.

title: Messaging: start conversation and send messages
description: Prereq: a design request (CLIENT) and a vendor profile. With the CLIENT token, POST /api/v1/conversations/ with {design_request: <id>, vendor: <vendor_id>} returns 201. POST /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages/ with {body: 'Hello'} returns 201. GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages/ returns 200 including the message.

title: Disputes: raise on order and admin resolves
description: Prereq: an order exists. With the CLIENT token, POST /api/v1/disputes/ with {order: <id>, reason, description} returns 201 with status 'open'. PATCH /api/v1/disputes/{dispute_id}/ with the CLIENT (non-admin) token must be forbidden (403). PATCH with the ADMIN token {status: 'resolved', resolution: 'Refund issued'} returns 200 and status becomes 'resolved'.

title: Analytics overview is admin-only
description: GET /api/v1/analytics/overview/ with the CLIENT token returns 403. With the ADMIN token it returns 200 with aggregate metrics.
